text:
lara: FYI we're planning a compact base-image push + runtime privilege shrink tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Need short-lived KMS decrypt for the staging signer, audit streaming for cosign verify, and a confirmation on RBAC least-priv changes.

michael: Can we avoid granting `cryptoKeyDecrypter` to a wide group? prefer a single service account bound to a temporary group and a short TTL.

lara: Plan is: create `sa:image-unseal-canary@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, grant decrypter on the single key, and add the SA to `group:canary-svc-temp@redwood.ai` for 30m. After canary, revoke and rotate.

toni: Sounds good. For audit, we should forward cosign stdout to our secure index and include fields: principal, key, action, image:sha256, and run_id. Example cosign snippet in runbook:
```
cosign verify -key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/stage-sign \\ 
  --output json registry.redwood.ai/base:2026-03-10 | \
  jq '{principal:.verificationDetails[0].signer, key:.key, action:"verify", image:.critical.image.digest, run_id:"${RUN_ID}"}' \
  | logger -t image-sig-verify
```

lara: audit-bot, can you confirm forward target and retention?

audit-bot: Forwarding target `logs-redwood-image-audit` confirmed. Retention policy set to 15 months. Access: sec-team + infra-logs read, devs get redacted view.

michael: RBAC snippet I'll add to infra repo (ephemeral terraform resource with lifecycle and destroy job). Example: create binding then run `terraform destroy -target=google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.stage_decrypter -auto-approve` via scheduler after 30m. Also add a PR approval guard: pagerduty ack + 2nd sec approver.

toni: vuln triage: ran trivy on base-compact-2026-03-09: HIGH=0, MEDIUM=1(libssl), LOW=3. Patched in this build. re-scan before canary.

lara: deploy-bot please schedule a 30m canary at 01:00 UTC with 5% traffic and heath check frequency 15s. Post runbook link once scheduled.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-11T01:00:00Z — 30m window, 5% traffic. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/compact-base-canary. Notifying oncall and sec.

michael: After destroy, run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/stage-sign` and post to audit index. If binding present, auto-create issue and page sec-oncall.

lara: I'll update the runbook with rollback steps and cosign verification jq. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
